links.outcome: Model performance under real-world recording variation versus standardized test set
links.effect: Whisper/SVM reached 100% accuracy in-domain; out-of-domain deep learning models failed to generalize; MFCC/SVM best at 64.1% accuracy, macro F1 0.61.
links.quote: Cross-domain generalization testing on the out-of-domain dataset demonstrated severe performance degradation.

links.outcome: Overestimated performance on standardized test data versus external out-of-domain data
links.effect: Near-perfect in-domain performance (100% accuracy, 1.0 macro F1) fell to 64.1% accuracy and 0.61 macro F1 for the best model out-of-domain.
links.quote: State-of-the-art deep learning models failed to generalize.

screen.reason: The study performs out-of-domain validation to evaluate how speech-based ML models handle acoustic domain shift and real-world heterogeneity before clinical deployment.
